sources.title: Natural environment planning practice guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Planning guidance defines best and most versatile agricultural land as Grades 1, 2 and 3a and requires planning decisions to take account of its benefits; exact candidate status still requires spatial evidence.

sources.title: Agricultural land: assess proposals for development
sources.verified_claim: Natural England guidance explains how planning authorities and developers should assess proposals affecting agricultural land and protect BMV land from inappropriate development.

sources.title: Agricultural land classification Dataset
sources.verified_claim: Planning Data exposes a national Agricultural Land Classification dataset with Natural England attribution; dataset presence alone is not a parcel result without coordinate or geometry intersection.

sources.title: Predictive Agricultural Land Classification Map for England
sources.verified_claim: The 2026 Predictive ALC map is a strategic-scale national view and includes the Grade 3a/3b subdivision; Grades 1, 2 and 3a are BMV.

sources.title: Agricultural Land Classification (ALC) Grades - Post 1988 Survey (polygons)
sources.verified_claim: Natural England publishes detailed post-1988 ALC survey polygons with grade and job information; detailed surveys can supersede strategic mapping where they cover a site.

sources.title: Land Use Framework
sources.verified_claim: The 2026 Land Use Framework commits to stronger open land-use evidence, including predictive ALC and open soil data, to support decisions balancing food production, development and nature.

sources.title: Land Use Framework publications
sources.verified_claim: The collection links the new land-use evidence products, including the updated ALC map and open National Soil Map, but these remain contextual until intersected with a candidate.

sources.title: NPPF Chapter 15: Conserving and enhancing the natural environment
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: NPPF policy requires planning decisions to recognise the economic and other benefits of BMV agricultural land and soils; it does not by itself classify a candidate parcel.
